svg.title: Tokens to finish ARC-AGI-3
svg.desc: Tokens each harness put through the model to finish the 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games. On Claude Opus 5.5, both scoring 100: Nodecode 181M tokens ($124), Claude Code 393M ($210). On GPT-6.1 Sol, both winning all 25 games: Nodecode 58M ($33), Codex CLI 172M ($43).
svg.text: ARC-AGI-3 · TOKENS TO FINISH, LESS IS BETTER
all 25 games, both winning every one
